import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 20;
    static final int MAXV = 2 * MAXN * MAXN;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static char[][] grid1 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] timeInfected = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int N, T;
    static int[] dirX = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dirY = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static boolean isWalk(char c) { return c >= '0' && c <= '9'; }
    static boolean isNum(char c) { return c >= '1' && c <= '9'; }

    static class Dinic {
        ArrayList<Integer>[] adj;
        int[] cap;
        int[] dist;
        boolean[] vis;

        Dinic() {
            adj = new ArrayList[MAXV];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXV; i++) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            cap = new int[MAXV * MAXV];
            dist = new int[MAXV];
            vis = new boolean[MAXV];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
            adj[u].add(v);
            adj[v].add(u);
            cap[u * MAXV + v] = c;
            cap[v * MAXV + u] = 0;
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            dist[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int v : adj[u]) {
                    if (cap[u * MAXV + v] > 0 && dist[v] == -1) {
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                        q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[t] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int t, int flow) {
            if (u == t) return flow;
            vis[u] = true;
            for (int v : adj[u]) {
                if (cap[u * MAXV + v] > 0 && !vis[v] && dist[v] == dist[u] + 1) {
                    int got = dfs(v, t, Math.min(flow, cap[u * MAXV + v]));
                    if (got > 0) {
                        cap[u * MAXV + v] -= got;
                        cap[v * MAXV + u] += got;
                        return got;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int ans = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(vis, false);
                int got;
                while ((got = dfs(s, t, INF)) > 0) ans += got;
            }
            return ans;
        }
    }

    static Dinic dinic = new Dinic();

    static void infectedBFS(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            Arrays.fill(timeInfected[i], INF);
        timeInfected[sx][sy] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dirX[d], ny = y + dirY[d];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N) continue;
                if (isWalk(grid1[nx][ny]) && timeInfected[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    timeInfected[nx][ny] = timeInfected[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void createEdges(int sx, int sy) {
        int[][] d = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) Arrays.fill(d[i], INF);
        d[sx][sy] = 0;
        if (isNum(grid2[sx][sy]))
            dinic.addEdge(N * sx + sy, N * N + N * sx + sy, INF);

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + dirX[k], ny = y + dirY[k];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N) continue;
                if (d[nx][ny] != INF) continue;
                if (!isWalk(grid1[nx][ny])) continue;
                int nd = d[x][y] + 1;
                if (nd <= Math.min(timeInfected[nx][ny] - 1, T)) {
                    d[nx][ny] = nd;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
                if (nd <= Math.min(timeInfected[nx][ny], T) && isNum(grid2[nx][ny]))
                    dinic.addEdge(N * sx + sy, N * N + N * nx + ny, INF);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        int zx = 0, zy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                grid1[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    zx = i; zy = j;
                } else if (isNum(grid1[i][j])) {
                    dinic.addEdge(MAXV - 2, i * N + j, grid1[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        infectedBFS(zx, zy);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                grid2[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (isNum(grid2[i][j]))
                    dinic.addEdge(N * N + i * N + j, MAXV - 1, grid2[i][j] - '0');
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
                if (isNum(grid1[i][j])) createEdges(i, j);

        System.out.println(dinic.maxFlow(MAXV - 2, MAXV - 1));
        sc.close();
    }
}
